exposure: Obesity class I and II (BMI 30-39.9 kg/m(2))
outcome: Accuracy of ultrasound for fetal weight estimation
cohort: Obese patients (BMI ≥30 kg/m(2)) who gave birth after 28-week gestation of viable singleton
finding: The study found no significant difference in ultrasound accuracy for fetal weight estimation between obese and morbidly obese patients.
mod_finding: This study found a higher rate of cesarean delivery in the obese cohort, with a significant proportion being repeat cesarean sections.
